work.permit: Autorización del órgano competente para la protección de niños, niñas y adolescentes

note: Work: the Organic Law of Labour and Workers (Decreto 8.938 con Rango, Valor y Fuerza de Ley Orgánica del Trabajo, los Trabajadores y las Trabajadoras, Gaceta Oficial 6.076 Extraordinario of 7 May 2012, read from FAOLEX's scan of the gazette, whose text layer misreads some letters, e.g. 'cuarido' for 'cuando'), article 32: the work of children and adolescents under fourteen is forbidden, save artistic and cultural activities authorised by the competent body for the protection of children and adolescents; the work of adolescents from fourteen to eighteen follows the Constitution and the Organic Law for the Protection of Children and Adolescents (LOPNNA), whose own rules (registration, hours) weren't read. No age floor for performers. Majority: null; the Civil Code (article 18) wasn't read in any official copy; Venezuela's government legal sites (the labour ministry, the defence ministry) failed at the proxy on 2026-10-31. Service: null; the Law of Conscription and Military Enlistment (2009) and the defence ministry's pages weren't reached.
